content: प्रक्रिया .²1 Way, manner, conduct; प्रक्रियेयं न ते युक्ता <ls>Mb. 14. 79. 3</ls>. .²2 A rite, ceremony. .²3 The bearing of royal insignia. .²4 High position, elevation. .²5 A chapter or section (of a book); as in उणादिप्रक्रिया. .²6 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Etymological formation. .²7 A privilege. .²8 An introductory chapter of a work. .²9 Rules for the formation of words. .²10 Good conduct, action; प्रक्रिया वैरिकारिका <ls>Mb. 12. 111. 59</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> प्रक्रिया प्रकृष्टं कर्म) .²11 (In medicine) a prescription.
